resources.string: Beam complete. Received text is saved below.
Pairing timed out. Return to Touchbeam and restart Send or Receive.
Nearby visibility ended. Paired phones can still connect. Cancel and tap Receive again to become visible.
Looking for phones with Touchbeam ready…
Ready to receive. Visible nearby for about two minutes. On the other phone tap Send, then select this phone.
Ready for paired phones. Pair-free setup is unavailable. For new phones, cancel and choose Receive with Bluetooth visibility.
Waiting for Android pairing. Approve the matching code on both phones, then return to Touchbeam.

Ready to tap. The other phone can use Receive, or leave Touchbeam with Ready in background enabled. Hold the backs together. Supported phones connect without pairing. Or choose a phone manually below.
Tap recognized. Finding that exact receiver over Bluetooth… You can separate the phones. Keep the receiver ready.
Could not find the tapped receiver. Check its ready notification, or keep Receive open. New phones need temporary visibility. Tap again, or choose a phone manually.
Tap recognized. Finding that exact receiver over Bluetooth…\n%1$s
Turn Bluetooth on to receive. Stop disables background readiness.
Ready while unlocked · paired phones can tap to beam. New phones need temporary visibility.
Connected. Incoming files need your acceptance in the incoming notification.
Received text is saved in Touchbeam. Tap to view it.
Accept only if you expect this beam. Review the filenames below. Open Touchbeam for the full list. You have 60 seconds to decide.
Ready when this app is closed. Use Receive while the Touchbeam screen is open.

Enable once, then leave Touchbeam. Verified NFC taps on supported Android 10+ phones receive files automatically while unlocked. Classic fallback asks for Accept and may need pairing and temporary visibility. Stop in the notification turns this off.
Allow Nearby devices and notifications to enable background readiness. Check that both Touchbeam notification channels are enabled.
Background readiness enabled. Leave this screen to listen; the notification shows the current state.
An incoming background beam is in progress. Accept or decline it in the notification, or turn off Ready in background to cancel it.
Android could not start background readiness. Open Touchbeam and try the switch again.
No file offer is waiting. Incoming files appear in a notification with Accept and Decline.

Classic visibility ended. Pair-free NFC taps are still ready.
NFC tap verified. Waiting for the sender to tap the Beam preview. This beam will receive automatically.
